release_notes:
SGB Browser v2.0.45 Official Complete Public Stability & Upgrade Release:
• Critical Crash & Glitch Fixes (100% Stability Overhaul): Fixed missing 're' import inside Bot #7 UI (eliminated 3,500+ runtime NameErrors), fixed missing 'hashlib' import inside core suite enhancements, hardened _ArrowSpinBox QPainter rendering guards for all Windows GPUs/drivers, protected all background VPN probe signals & closeEvent timers against premature-close crashes, and rebuilt the entire Bot #7 engine cleanly from the verified smooth codebase.
• Added Bot #7 Instant Expired/Wrong OTP Auto-Exit across 40+ languages (plus universal red error banner & red text detection so invalid/expired OTPs exit immediately without wasting timeout).
• Added Bot #7 Strict 2FA / Google Authenticator & Permanent Disabled Profile Block (blocks 2FA/Authenticator & Disabled IDs from ever being saved to Profile Manager while preserving all LIVE & Recoverable Locked IDs).
• Upgraded 5-Point Universal Dynamic VPN Re-Login across all providers (Surfshark, NordVPN, PIA, Windscribe, IPVanish, Custom): smart newest-to-oldest live credential auto-picker (never gets stuck on old expired 407 accounts), automatic blacklist & Global Bridge reset on re-login, multi-node verification, and instant 407 Auth Expired detection.
• Includes 9-Mode Anti-Detect Engine ('iPhone Old Safari' & 'Brave Mobile Browser'), Permanent Zero-Trace Ephemeral Cleanup, 50-Thread Headless GraphQL Number Filter, crisp Up/Down spinbox arrows, and Zero-Freeze 4GB/8GB RAM optimization.
